parsed.public_message: Orange: Blue's ~21 units (3 armored elephants, cavalry, swords, 6 archers, 2 surgeons, Seleucus) win on value at t=800 if they stay intact. Orange's spears are in Blue now. Orange accepts Green's offer, is neutral to Green and keeps its word to White. Next pause (t=675): Green from the north, White from the west, Orange from the south - all on Blue.

private_messages.GPT: Accepted: Orange is neutral to Green from this turn, as you proposed. Please set Orange neutral and keep your archers on Blue, its archers and surgeons first. My spears are in Blue's army now. At t=675 let's hit Blue at the same moment: you from the north, Orange from the south. I am asking White to come from the west.
private_messages.Grok: The pact holds: Orange will not strike White, and you get a full turn's notice before any change. Blue still has 21 units (3 armored elephants, Companion cavalry, swordsmen, 6 archers, 2 surgeons, Seleucus) and wins on value at t=800 if it stays intact. None of us beats that score otherwise. My spears are in Blue now. At t=675 please send Alexander at Blue's archers and surgeons from the west while Green shoots from the north.

parsed.explanation: With Orange's swordsmen and elephant squad no longer on the field, Orange has 12 spearmen, one cavalryman and Hannibal against Blue's 21-unit army, which wins on value at t=800 if it stays intact. Orange accepts Green's neutrality offer, keeps its pact with White, and sends the spearmen into Blue (spearmen counter Blue's cavalry). Hannibal holds about 45 m behind them so his 500 points survive, and Orange calls for a three-sided strike on Blue at the next pause.
